MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

5. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 15

7. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 50

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

23. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 8

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 36

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 105
   D. 30

26. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 6
   C. 14
   D. 8

27. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

28. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

29. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 11

30. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
